metadata.question: Was there an active fire present near Paradise, California between November 7, 2018 to November 10, 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Paradise, California (coordinates ~39.76°N, 121.62°W) - Date range: November 7-10, 2018 (This is the Camp Fire period!) - Collection: MODIS or VIIRS active fire products (MOD14A1, MYD14A1, or VIIRS) - Best option: FIRMS (Fire Information for Resource Management System) or MODIS Thermal Anomalies/Fire products 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for fire detection - Focus on FireMask band or confidence levels - MODIS: Use 'FireMask' or 'MaxFRPAT' (Fire Radiative Power) - Alternative: Use Landsat 8 thermal bands to detect temperature anomalies 3. Logic: - Valid fire detection (pixel count > 0 with fire) → A (Yes) - No fire pixels detected → B (No) - No images in collection → C1 - Images exist but no valid pixels after processing → C2 - Calculation error → C3 I'll use MODIS/Aqua Thermal Anomalies (MYD14A1) and MODIS/Terra (MOD14A1) which provide daily fire detection data. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define location and time period const paradise = ee.Geometry.Point([-121.6219, 39.7596]); // Paradise, CA const buffer = paradise.buffer(10000); // 10km radius const startDate = '2018-11-07'; const endDate = '2018-11-11'; // Inclusive of Nov 10 console.log("Analyzing fire activity near Paradise, CA"); console.log("Date range: Nov 7-10, 2018"); console.log("Search radius: 10km"); // 2. Try MODIS Terra Thermal Anomalies (MOD14A1) let fireCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD14A1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(buffer); let colSize = fireCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`MODIS Terra images found: ${colSize}`); // 3. If no Terra data, try Aqua if (colSize === 0) { fireCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MYD14A1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(buffer); colSize = fireCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`MODIS Aqua images found: ${colSize}`); } // 4. Check if any images exist if (colSize === 0) { console.log("No MODIS fire data available for this period."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 5. Process fire detection // FireMask band: 0-8 with values 7-9 indicating fires const fireDetection = fireCol.map(function(img) { const fireMask = img.select('FireMask'); // Fire pixels have values >= 7 (7=low confidence, 8=nominal, 9=high confidence) const fire = fireMask.gte(7); return fire.selfMask(); }); const fireComposite = fireDetection.max(); // 6. Count fire pixels const fireStats = fireComposite.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: buffer, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const firePixelCount = fireStats.get('FireMask').getInfo(); // 7. Get maximum fire radiative power for context const frpStats = fireCol.select('MaxFRP').max().reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.max(), geometry: buffer, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const maxFRP = frpStats.get('MaxFRP').getInfo(); // 8. Validation and output console.log(`Fire pixels detected: ${firePixelCount || 0}`); console.log(`Maximum Fire Radiative Power: ${maxFRP || 0} MW`); if (firePixelCount === null || firePixelCount === undefined) { console.log("Calculation failed - unable to determine fire presence."); console.log("C3"); return; } if (firePixelCount === 0) { console.log("No fire pixels detected in the area during this period."); console.log("B"); } else { console.log("Active fire detected during this period."); console.log("A"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
